verdict.rationale: LathamDrive is an open public site with plain-language resources organized by startup stage (Formation, Capital Raising, Scaling & Operations, etc.), including a document generator, FAQs answered by Latham lawyers, and a free public glossary (Book of Jargon) covering founder/equity terms like SAFEs, vesting, and 409A valuations. This directly matches the story of an open startup knowledge base with guides/FAQs/explainers on formation, financing, and equity. Missing for 10: no direct hands-on excerpt of the FAQ answers' content or independent third-party corroboration of usage/quality.
